data.long_meaning: Ram is a popular Hindu God's name and Milana means union. So Rammilan can be interpreted as the union with Ram or God. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rammilan usually hope their child will grow to embody god's name and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rammilan total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rammilan holds great significance in Hindu culture as it is a reminder of the devotion and devotional practices towards the Hindu deity, Lord Rama. It celebrates the belief in the power and grace of Lord Rama, as well as the importance of seeking his divine guidance and protection in everyday life.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Rammilan is deeply rooted in the Hindu belief of the ultimate goal of human life being to attain moksha (liberation) through the divine grace of God. The name Rammilan represents the deep yearning and longing for that divine union, symbolizing the inner journey of the soul towards the ultimate reality, which is the union with the all-pervading cosmic consciousness or God. It invokes a sense of inner peace, devotion, and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Rammilan signifies the embodiment of Rama's divine virtues, symbolizing strength, devotion, and selfless service to the divine and humanity. It is a reminder to remain steadfast in the pursuit of dharma and righteousness.
